description: This file defines a utility class `Log` that serves as a wrapper around Android's native logging system. It manages log levels, chains LogNode instances for custom logging behavior, and provides static methods for various log levels like verbose, debug, info, warn, error, and assert. The class primarily facilitates logging within an Android project, allowing for flexible log handling and customization.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging at various levels, encapsulating Android's native logging mechanisms and allowing chaining of LogNode instances for custom log processing.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message to the current LogNode with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level with optional throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level with optional throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level with optional throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, with overloads for throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level with optional throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level with optional throwable.
